scope.summary: Follow-up evidence and browser regression coverage for automatic, idempotent Xero payroll mapping destinations; no payroll submission.
implemented: Selected authorized Xero tenants create one business-scoped payroll mapping destination using the tenant UUID; existing connected tenants are backfilled idempotently.
Generic manual destination creation excludes Xero and connected organizations link to their exact destination.
Synthetic browser coverage verifies auto-creation, exact navigation, explicit employee mappings, and destination/mapping preservation through reauthorization.

evidence.outcome: The prior merged OAuth slice records confirmation of AU Payroll v2 POST /Timesheets and the payroll.timesheets scope against the Xero OpenAPI contract.
The follow-up documents Payroll AU Timesheets 2.0 and links the official endpoint and OAuth scopes references.

criteria.description: OAuth refresh and permission failure handled

evidence.outcome: Prior merged evidence records passing mocked refresh, token rotation, revoked credentials, provider permission-error, refresh-lock, and database role-isolation coverage.
This follow-up additionally verifies that reauthorizing the same synthetic tenant preserves its destination ID and explicit employee mappings.

criteria.description: sandbox end-to-end test validates mapping, retries and duplicate prevention.

Actual Xero sandbox submission, provider retry behavior, and remote duplicate prevention remain unverified; this change enables no Xero API writes.
